answer: An agent registers only when a fresh remote-attestation quote proves that its enclave runs the approved code, identified by MRENCLAVE, on trusted hardware. Names such as pigment, wharf, and yarrow are not identities by themselves: duplicating them in virtual machines cannot forge the quote. Sybil resistance therefore depends on hardware-backed attestation and scarce silicon; MRENCLAVE measures code, not a unique chip, so it must not be treated as a per-device identifier.
